title: Orochi: Seventh Echoes Pilot Film

alternative_titles.ja: 『オロチ -Seventh Echoes-』パイロット映像

synopsis:
Kukulkan is a kingdom sustained by sound waves. Born with a power known as "Hizumi," Agni was abandoned by the royal family and grew up surrounded by his guardian and friends. His power awakens Orochi, a force of calamity believed to have died a thousand years ago.When Orochi awakens, he calls Agni "my son."

Who is Agni? What is this power for? To protect those he loves, the boy confronts the threat he has awakened. An epic adventure begins as sound and myth resonate together.

(Source: BLUE RIGHTS)
